notes.title: Demo Update 1.5.4
notes.content:
[*]The opening screen now includes a "Intended for Mature Audiences" message.
[*]The area around the bus stop has been completely redesigned.
[*]Directional signs for the Candy Shop have been added.
[*] The seat in the Mike fight has been moved to the left, and a poster indicating health restoration is now above it.
[*] A poster has been added to the corridor leading to Ice Cream's studio.
[*]A prompt now shows you need to click to activate the vacuum, appearing after standing nearby for 2 seconds.
[*] Cutscenes have been added to showcase the fireballs and targets, as well as a cutscene for the fireball below.
[*] A checkpoint has been added to the rap sequence, and a new cutscene now plays when you fail. 
[*] The issue where failure was not being triggered has also been fixed.
[*] We've fixed the issues with autosave icon.
[*]Made several fixes and improvements.

Jump in and experience the changes!

notes.title: Demo Update 1.5.1
notes.content:
Demo is updated to version 1.5.1 with these changes:
* Mouse controls are polished, now they are fluid and perfect!
* Potato now gets ragdolled when died.
* Cutscene fast-forward and rewind effects are remade.
* Fixed the squash and stretch effect when hit enemies.
* Pick-up sound effect changed.
* “Got item” animations are remade.
* Fixed some cutscene triggers.
* Some environmental changes.
* Some minor fixes.

notes.title: Demo Update 1.4.5: New Minigame!
notes.content:
Demo Update 1.4.5: New Minigame!

- Added a new minigame: “Shoot the Donkey in the Ass!”, and a leaderboard along with it!
- Added a leaderboard for “ULTRA PUNCH!”
- Redrawn the room icons.
- Made the doors bigger, and some walls higher.
- Added a halloween section to make a memory.
- Made some visual changes to the park.
- Now leaderboards close when you move away.
- Leaderboards now show the game names.
- Made some visual changes to the loading animation.

Thanks for playing, we are waiting for your feedback at our Discord!

notes.title: Potato Mash! Demo Update 1.3.3
notes.content:
Hi. We have updated the demo again, to version 1.3.3 with these changes:

- Recording studio cutscene has changed a bit.
- Added a new poster.
- The dialogue bubble chaos at the end is fixed.
- Rap song has changed a bit.
- Rap video has changed a bit.
- Some visual updates.
- Added a mouse click indicator at the slider near the candy shop.
- Fixed the dancing mini game.

Thanks for playing, we are waiting for your feedback at our Discord!

notes.title: New Update For Demo!
notes.content:
We're trying to create the best version of Potato Mash ever can be! So, with weeks of work; we have managed to improve the demo even further!

Update Notes (v1.3.0)

Notable:
[list]
[*] Added saving indicators to show that the game is being saved.
[*] Added checkpoints for: Mike’s fight, after greasing, each wave of the final fights .
[*] Added “switch on the lights” section before the recording.
[*] Now we see through the pipes in the park when we go inside them.
[/list]
Graphics:
[list]
[*] Redesigned the movie studio.
[*] Redesigned “low health screen effects” for being more harsh.
[*] Changed the room labels to room icons in corridors.
[*] Changed objective texts style a bit.
[*] Redesigned “failed” text.
[*] Added lights to the fireballs.
[*] Added animations for the moustaches getting greased.
[*] Changed some tutorial posters from text to visual only.
[*] Added LUT for a more balanced and atmospheric look.
[/list]
Sound:
[olist]
[*] Fixed the music players.
[*] Fixed the oiling sounds.
[*] Fixed ambient sounds.
[*] Fixed brown bat sound.
[*] Fixed pimp burning sounds.
[/olist]
Game Design:
[list]
[*] The game is now a bit easier because of the checkpoints and the see-through pipe. 
[/list]
Language:
[list]
[*] Now the posters are localized too.​
[*] Fixes for several languages.
[/list]
Technical Improvements and Fixes:
[list]
[*] Optimized for better performance.
[*] Several other minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: BIG UPDATE FOR THE DEMO!
notes.content:
Since we want you to have the best possible experience on Potato Mash!, we have updated the demo with the a pack of new features and fixes!

Update Notes (v1.12)
Features:
* Integrated Steam Leaderboards to “BING!”, the math game.
* Added a punch machine both for tutorial and practicing.
* Added a full-fledged menu with huge re-design; which has more controls over audio and graphics settings.
Technical Improvements and Fixes:
* Now the game renders with one camera instead of two cameras. So performance will be improved, the ordering issues among the layers are fixed, and the characters are now affected by lighting and visual effects.
* Fixed the “Default” line from Ice Cream’s cutscene.
* Fixed the healing when paused
* Ground collisions are fixed now. There will be no objects going down there.
Language:
* Added Turkish, Ukrainian and Russian, Hungarian language support
Sound:
* Sound effects added for picking up power ups and healing.
* Added music to the Dog’s cutscene.
* Added a music before the music video recording part.
* Reworked the fight music of Chicken Mike.
* Reworked the intro music.
* Reworked the menu music.
Game Design:
* Decreased the difficulty of final part.
* Decreased the healing speed but increased the healing amount.
Graphics:
* Most of the characters are redesigned and given them more detail.
* Ice Cream’s room is now more detailed.
* Added visual effects added for healing.
* More posters added.
Other: 
* Now the game has its own fictional illness.

notes.title: Potato Mash! Livestream
notes.content:
Hi!

We have published Potato Mash! Demo for the Next Fest! While you can try it yourself, we will also demonstrate the game through livestream!

What is Potato Mash; for anyone who wants to briefly learn about the game:

An Action-Adventure game where you control a cute evil potato, fully with your mouse. Freely fly, smash your enemies, play various mini games while playing the humorous & satirical story of Marvin, the Potato.

notes.title: We have an exciting announcement!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Gamers,
[/h2]

 Our first game, Potato Mash! will be released on Steam a few months later. Potato Mash! offers an enchanting experience with innovative gameplay and a satirical storyline.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lpiccpw_QGo

Potato Mash! is carefully crafted by a solo developer with a lot of help from a friend. Surprisingly, the development started as a space shooter and evolved into this special game in a short period of time. The game has been in development for two years and will be released soon. After the release, we'll continue to improve the game based on player feedback. We've also set up a Steam Community page where you can contact us, ask questions, give feedback and communicate with other players.

The demo will be available on Steam this week. You can visit the Potato Mash! Steam page to learn more about the game. You can also follow us on our social media accounts for more content and updates on the game.

We'd like to thank everyone who has supported us along the way. This game wouldn't have been possible without your feedback and support. We invite you into the world of Potato Mash! and hope you'll enjoy our game.

We can't wait to meet you!

Best regards,

Cardiac Games
